command:
set -eu
cfg=/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/60-dropbox-sftp.conf
if [ -e "$cfg" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'refusing to overwrite existing dropbox SSH configuration' >&2
  exit 1
fi
tmp=$(mktemp /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/.dropbox-sftp.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
cat > "$tmp" <<'ANTRIEB_SFTP_CONFIG'
# Managed SFTP-only account: dropbox
Match User dropbox
    ChrootDirectory /srv/sftp/%u
    ForceCommand internal-sftp -d /incoming -u 0027
    AuthorizedKeysFile /etc/ssh/authorized_keys/%u
    PubkeyAuthentication yes
    PasswordAuthentication no
    KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
    PermitTTY no
    AllowAgentForwarding no
    AllowTcpForwarding no
    X11Forwarding no
    PermitTunnel no
Match all
ANTRIEB_SFTP_CONFIG
chown root:root "$tmp"
chmod 0600 "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" "$cfg"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
restorecon "$cfg"
if ! /usr/sbin/sshd -t; then
  rm -f "$cfg"
  exit 1
fi
systemctl reload sshd
printf 'config_test='; /usr/sbin/sshd -t && printf 'ok\n'
printf 'sshd_active='; systemctl is-active sshd
printf '%s\n' '[effective dropbox policy]'
/usr/sbin/sshd -T -C user=dropbox,host=node1,addr="$NODE_IP" | grep -E '^(chrootdirectory|forcecommand|authorizedkeysfile|pubkeyauthentication|passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|permittty|allowagentforwarding|allowtcpforwarding|x11forwarding|permittunnel) '
